vaultoPolicy: A deposit limit of 0 or a stale NAV → DEFER (temporarily paused, waiting NAV refresh), not REJECT.

Direct contract builds only as a fallback when the IXS MCP fails for a non-safety reason, and never when the deposit-limit or NAV checks fail. In Replay (a past block, simulation only) calldata is encoded directly because the MCP builds against the current state only.
No mock tokens or mock vaults: only the vaults listed by the IXS Vault API and the asset their contracts report through asset().

Live deposits into ixv1 need at least 104 USDC = ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03), so the position stays redeemable above the 100 USDC net minimum (minRedeemAssets) after the 0.5% fee (feeBps) with a 3% NAV buffer.
Settlement of async requests is estimated at about one business day after the cutoff, and Singapore public holidays come from the public calendar: both are Vaulto assumptions, not IXS statements.
A NAV older than 72 h, or older than the contract's navStalenessThreshold(), is treated as stale.

Concentration: one leg may take at most min(policy cap, 25% of the vault's TVL = totalAssets before the deposit), never below the 100 USDC minimum; if that cap is below 100 USDC the vault is deferred for capacity.

sections.heading: Treasury condition
sections.body: The treasury is fully idle at 1,987,865 USD, with 1,987,865 USD in idle capital and 23 idle days. The policy profile is Balanced, with a 30% liquidity floor, a 70% maximum BTC exposure, and a minimum vault risk score of 80.

sections.heading: Policy
sections.body: Live redeemable minimum: ixv1 ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03) = 104 USDC, which keeps the whole position redeemable above the 100 USDC net minimum after the 0.5% redeem fee with a 3% NAV buffer. Live mode is opt-in; when enabled, it requires the wallet’s signature and is capped per transaction by the guardrail.

sections.heading: Proposed allocation
sections.body: Allocate 163.96 USDC to IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB on BNB Chain. This leg is 25% of the vault’s TVL before the deposit, and the concentration guardrail capped it; the resulting share after deposit is 20%.

sections.heading: Deferred (waiting NAV refresh)
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh because its deposit limit is 0 USDC and NAV is stale at 10.4 days ago, with a quoted share price of 1.090228 USDC/share. It unblocks when NAV refreshes and the deposit limit reopens above the 100 USDC minimum.

sections.heading: Rejected
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB · Licensed is rejected because the wallet is not whitelisted, the deposit limit is 0 USDC, and NAV is stale at 6.4 days ago. IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche · Licensed is rejected because the wallet is not whitelisted, the deposit limit is 0 USDC, and NAV is stale at 10.4 days ago. BTC Real Yield is rejected because no vault is deployed, so there is no open candidate vault to allocate to.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: The main risks are RWA credit risk, the daily redemption cycle, the 0.5% redemption fee, NAV drift between updates, and smart-contract and counterparty risk. Vault concentration is also relevant here: the approved leg is capped at 25% of the vault’s TVL before the deposit, which limits single-vault concentration but does not remove underlying protocol or asset risk.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Replay: BNB mainnet state @ block 123779792 (NAV fresh at that block) (added by Vaulto): every fact is the mainnet state at that block, read through an archive RPC; the simulation runs at that block and nothing is sent. Mode: Simulate by default. The approved BNB leg is simulated on BNB Chain mainnet; nothing is sent on-chain. For async legs, requests would be processed at the next cutoff at 17:00 SGT on Singapore business days, with settlement estimated about one business day later; Live mode is only used if opted in, requires the wallet’s signature, and is capped per transaction by the guardrail.
